Games

A game at every stop.

Prepare the order, solve the case, tidy the room. Fourteen games, all in English, at every level from A1 to C1.

And 10 more games
  • Cozy ChoresFollow the sentences and tidy a painted kitchen step by step.
  • Your CallYou choose what to say, and the story follows.
  • Mini CrossWrite the words you learned into the crossword.
  • Word RushFlip the tiles and match each word to its meaning.
  • Story HuntFind the hidden words in your story.
  • Build ItTap the tiles and build the sentence.
  • Word BingoListen to the clue, tap the word.
  • Say It BackListen to the sentence and say it back.
  • Listen & TypeListen to the sentence and type what you hear.
  • Trap DashPick the right form, fast.
